name: Small Stars Series 1
packaging: Blue backpack capsule, one figure inside
packagingNote: Series 1 is the BLUE backpack wave. This is a Mattel Small Stars backpack rather than a Disney Doorables pack, and it holds ONE figure.
sourced: Eight figures, transcribed from the complete Series 1 lineup shown by Plastic Soul and cross-checked against the figures opened in the same video. Mattel confirms the product but does not publish each wave's roster, so this remains community-sourced and is not marked verified.
rarityNote: Mattel says each wave has one hard-to-find figure, but the material reviewed does not identify which one, so no rarity is shown.
codeNote: The three-digit figure code is printed on the bottom of the backing card after the production text. Enter the final three digits, such as 001. These observed codes have no leading batch letter. TOY SHOTS demonstrated all eight blue-backpack codes; Mattel has not published them, so they remain unofficial and may differ in another production run.
